name: agentlink
description: Build apps with Supabase as the backend. Equips AI agents with schema-driven workflows, RPC-first data access, edge functions, auth, RLS, and multi-tenancy.

interface.shortDescription: Full-stack Supabase apps, built the opinionated way
interface.longDescription: AgentLink teaches coding agents how to build full-stack apps on Supabase: RPC-first data access through an isolated `api` schema, row-level security on every table, edge functions for anything that talks to the outside world, and Postgres-native cron + queues for background work. Ships an entry-point builder skill plus seven domain skills (cli, database, rpc, auth, edge-functions, frontend, notifications) and a hook that blocks destructive database commands.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new Supabase app with AgentLink.
Add a tenant-scoped table with RLS and the RPCs to read and write it.
Deploy my edge functions to the dev environment.
